Delicious food with a breathtaking view
Jul 2025 • Family
We had a truly special dining experience here, with a wide variety of options on the menu. The local dishes, bamboo-cooked rice (cơm lam), and black chicken were all incredibly appealing, fresh, and richly flavored, perfectly suiting my whole family's taste.What I loved most, however, was the ambiance. The feeling of dining amidst vast nature, gazing at the majestic Mường Hoa valley, and breathing in the fresh air was incredibly relaxing. It was truly an ideal evening!
